Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack compromising SolarWinds Orion software
Access and potential exfiltration of encrypted service account credentials
Use of compromised self-issued certificates to authenticate to Mimecast products
Targeting Microsoft 365 tenants via stolen certificates
Impacted Systems: Mimecast customers' encrypted service account credentials
Mimecast tenants' connections to on-premise and cloud services including LDAP, Azure Active Directory, Exchange Web Services, POP3 journaling, SMTP-authenticated delivery routes
Attack Vector: Compromised SolarWinds Orion software supply chain
Use of stolen self-issued certificates for authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Access to encrypted service account credentials
Compromised self-issued certificates used for Microsoft 365 authentication
Targeting of Mimecast customers' M365 tenants
